claims.statement: The canonical task/session identifier is the task_id field inside .agents/sessions/<folder>/summary.json; the folder name YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-short-topic is only a sortable storage label and must not be used to infer identity.

Each task-closeout bundle must contain exactly five files: summary.json, active-task.md, learning-candidate.md, changed-files.txt, and validation.txt, with summary.json requiring task_id and optionally carrying openspec_change, repo_id, agent, and distillation flags.

When a session worked on an OpenSpec change, summary.json records it in openspec_change (the change name under openspec/changes/<name>/); when no change was involved the field is absent or null, and closeout succeeds normally.
Spec updates happen at /opsx:archive time, not during task closeout; closeout leaves files under openspec/ untouched for in-flight changes and notes pending spec updates for archive time.

task-closeout writes only under .agents/sessions/<session-folder>/ and never creates or edits .agents/AGENTS.md, openwiki/**, .agents/playbooks/**, .agents/skills/**, or openspec/ for in-flight changes; proposed durable or skill changes are recorded as prose in the bundle for learning-distill to apply.
After closeout the bundle is immutable except for status and distillation-related fields in summary.json (distilled, distillation_status) that a later tool may update.

learning-distill fails closed before any wiki write: it verifies openspec and openwiki binaries are on PATH via check_peer_tools.mjs and that openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md carries the AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers, stopping without writes and printing remediation (npm i -g commands or attach_wiki_contract.mjs) on failure.

learning-distill routes lessons by kind: descriptive lessons (facts, rationale, architecture, troubleshooting patterns, repo decisions) become OKF pages under openwiki/{decisions,troubleshooting}/ or topical openwiki/ pages, while prescriptive lessons (agent behavior rules, multi-step procedures) stay in .agents/AGENTS.md or .agents/playbooks/; cross-zone placement is prohibited.
Distillation never duplicates a SHALL requirement already codified in openspec/specs/ as a wiki page; wiki pages record facts and rationale and must cite the spec capability instead.

Distillation never invokes openwiki --update; it authors wiki pages directly after loading authoring guidance from openwiki/dist/agent/prompt.js (createSystemPrompt) and validates frontmatter via openwiki/dist/okf/frontmatter.js (validateOkfFrontmatter), then refreshes indexes deterministically.

Wiki index refresh is performed deterministically by node .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/scripts/sync_wiki_indexes.mjs, which locates the global openwiki package via npm root -g, imports agent/docs-only-backend.js and okf/index-sync.js, constructs OpenWikiLocalShellBackend with docsOnly:true and virtualMode:true, and calls synchronizeWikiIndexes, keeping curated page bodies byte-identical while rebuilding index.md catalogs; it exits 2 with remediation if the wiki is uninitialized or the package is missing.

Per-task folders under .agents/sessions/ are gitignored via sessions/* with !sessions/README.md (only README.md tracked); bundle discovery must use an ignore-blind method (filesystem ls/find or ripgrep --no-ignore-vcs) and filter by summary.json task_id and state fields, never by folder name or ignore-aware search.

The curation contract lives bounded by <!-- AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT:BEGIN --> / <!-- AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT:END --> inside openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md, owned by attach_wiki_contract.mjs which reads references/wiki-contract-template.md verbatim; it fails fast with openwiki --init if the file is missing, appends below existing content if markers are absent (stub-aware), and is idempotent/self-updating by refreshing only between markers when the template changed.

Curated wiki pages follow OKF base frontmatter (type, title, description, tags, timestamp) extended with aksk_status on decisions (accepted/superseded/provisional), optional aksk_superseded_by and aksk_depends_on with qualified decisions/<slug> or troubleshooting/<slug> references; entry identity is the filename stem unique within its tree.

After distillation the bundle is marked distilled via summary.json flags (distilled:true, distillation_status) and indexes are synced; there is no activity log to append — accountability lives in bundle flags plus git history, and docs-lint reports index drift as guidance to rerun sync rather than as a wiring failure.

The add-task-start change under openspec/changes/add-task-start/ is Proposal-only and not yet archived to openspec/specs/task-start/; it must be labeled as proposal and is not an active capability until archived, with task-start owning creation (seeding summary.json with task_id, created_at, status:in_progress and optional openspec_change) and task-closeout owning finalization while preserving task_id and openspec_change with fallback generation when no seed exists.

Durable knowledge writes to openwiki/, .agents/AGENTS.md, .agents/playbooks/, and .agents/skills/ occur only during learning-distill after fail-closed prerequisites pass; task-start and task-closeout write only under .agents/sessions/<session-folder>/ (plus idempotent README.md/.gitignore init) and record proposed durable changes as prose in the bundle for learning-distill to apply.
